[untitled BTM module] These genes outline the interface between proliferative arrest and inflammatory secretion that characterises cellular senescence. [untitled BTM module] The dominant theme here is transmembrane solute handling in polarized epithelia of liver and kidney, coupled to regulated vesicular secretion.
